metadata.title: Tidal Disruption Flares of Stars From Moderately Recoiled Black Holes

notes: No individual stars are identified. The paper discusses stellar populations—stars unbound from a recoiling black hole or host galaxy and stars in a bound cloud—but does not identify any specific Galactic unbound star candidates or provide stellar identifiers. Its references to “unbound stars” concern stars unbound from the black hole, not stars demonstrated to be unbound from the Milky Way.
